notes:
Lead source: inbound from support-automation newsletter — small support SaaS. Early discovery, self-serve signup then asked for a POC.
- Primary product wanted: hosted_api (fast onboarding, free credits).
- Workload: nightly batch summarization + live agent assistant for mid-volume accounts. Focus on: ticket_summarization, structured_output (map to case fields), tool_calling (trigger internal triage API to assign/close).
- Scale targets: currently 10k monthly tickets, expected to grow to 40k in 12 months. Burst: ~50 rps during morning sync windows. Latency objective: summary generation for short tickets ~ p50 < 300ms, p95 < 900ms acceptable for async summarization; live agent flow needs streaming < 500ms token latency. Cost sensitivity high — SMB budget; want cost estimates for 100k tokens/month and for 5M tokens/month.
- Model preference: open to smaller open models for summaries but want Redwood-hosted variants and clear perf profiles; interested in quantized variants and batching recommendations.
- Security: must pass SOC2 checklist, want SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs, retention controls (90 days default, option to purge), KMS optional. No residency requirement (US primary).
- POC scope: 2-week trial: integrate hosted API to produce structured JSON (subject, summary, priority, suggested_action, suggested_macro), run on 1k historical tickets, compare FRT and handle time delta. Team will provide sample export and a list of macros.
- Quote from Head of Product: "If we can shave 25-30% off average handle time with accurate summaries and macros we can convert to paid."
- Internal champions: Head of Product (Ava Long) + Eng lead (Rafael Ortiz). Procurement: lightweight, SMB legal review only.
- Potential upsell: Dedicated if throughput/cost needs spike later, Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching to reduce token costs.
- Risks/blockers: security review window (2–3 weeks), Eng bandwidth for integration (API client + tool-calling hooks), clarity on pricing for higher token tiers.
- Quick wins: run sample job in hosted API with structured output templates, show token/cost breakdown per 1k tickets, demo tool-calling to auto-assign tickets.
- Next steps (AE): upload sample export to Drive (done), confirm POC success criteria, align SE deep-dive (week of 3/15).
